title: How to Build an Expense Tracker App (Without Code) in 2026
summary: How to build an expense tracker app with receipt upload, categorization, multi-user support, and reports. Full-stack with AI in under 2 hours — no dev team needed.
body_markdown: Expensify is a mature product with features most small teams don't use — corporate cards, multi-entity accounting, Concur integration. A custom expense tracker has exactly the features your team needs and none it doesn't. It's also permanently free at small scale, versus Expensify's $5–9/user/month ongoing cost. The tradeoff: Expensify is ready immediately, while a Blink app takes 2 hours to build. For teams with specific workflows — custom approval chains, unusual categories, integration with internal tools — a custom app usually wins within 3–6 months.
